translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Le' beṉ' bish' na' le' beṉ' zan', ka le' chonḻilall'le X̱ancho Jesucrístona', beena' yoo balaaṉ xenna', aga nakzi beṉ' gakile.
Shi gana' ndop nllagle yidə to beṉ' nllin xbene'na' niy de or na' nakw xalaane' dii wen, na' ḻekzka' yidə to beṉ' yesh'do' na' nakwe' xalaane' dii ba bida' bichollee,
na' chle'shi'chile beena' ḻe nak xalaaninna', na' che'lene': “Wche' latji gani nak wen”, na' che'le beṉ' yesh'do'na': “Na'zə wze, li'”, wa ba che'lene': “Lo yo na'tezə wche'”,
¿aaga nakzin ba chle'ile baḻ beṉ' daa chwia chyile nak nake', na' ba chza'lall'le c̱hegake'?

Le' beṉ' bish'dawaa na' le' beṉ' zandawaa, ḻi wzenag dga: Chioza' ba wleje' beṉ'do'ka' nak beṉ' yesh' yell-lioni kweṉche do yic̱hj do lall'gake' gonḻilall'gake'ne' na' soalengake'ne' gana' chṉabi'e, kon ka ba bc̱hebe' gone' c̱he beṉ'ka' chakgakile'ne'.
Na' le', chonzile ḻegake' nakzi. ¿Aaga beṉ' wnia'kan' chsak'zi'gake' le' na' chjtaogake' xya c̱hele lao beṉ'ka' chṉabia'?
¿Aaga ḻegaken' chbell chṉegake' mal c̱he X̱anchona', beena' nakcho lall' nee, beena' ḻe zakii?
Dii wen inlleban chonle shi dii ḻi chonle daa llialote nllia Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' bia' gonle daa nan: “Goki bish' ljwello'na' ka chaki kwino'.”
Per shi nakzi beṉ' gakile, chx̱iṉj chḻenle, na' ba de xtoḻ'le daa bi chonle ka na ley c̱he Chioza'.
Shi to beṉ' zeje' chone' yog'te daa nllia ley c̱he Chioza' bia', per shi ton bi gone', doxente leya' chawan xya nape' doḻ'.
Chios, beena' wna: “Bi chiyaḻ' iṉeleno' beṉ' yoblə”, ḻekzka' wne': “Bi wito' beṉ'.” Na' shi chito' beṉ', ḻa'kzi bi chṉeleno' beṉ' yoblə, chyishjo' daa nllia ley c̱he'na' bia'.
Chiyaḻ' wshaljle wen na' wsa' c̱hele wen kon ka nllia leya' bia', ḻega beṉ' ṉezi wllin to lla leya' daa chisell chiḻa' cho' lao dii mala', wc̱hoglon c̱hecho.
Beṉ'ka' bi chiyesh'lallii beṉ', ḻekzka' Chioza' bi yiyesh'lallile' ḻegake' llana' wc̱hogloe' c̱he beṉ'. San beṉ'ka' chiyesh'lallii beṉ', Chioza' yiyesh'lallile' ḻegake'.
Le' beṉ' bish' na' le' beṉ' zan', bibi zjanayin iṉaz beṉ' nonḻilallee Chioza' shi bi nḻa' dii wenna' chone'. ¿Awak to daa nonḻilall'ze' yislan ḻe' shi bi chone' wen?
Iṉatezcho to beṉ' byo wa to noolə, beṉ' nakcho txen nonḻilall'cho Jesucrístona', bibi xalaane' de na' chyalljte dii yeej gawe' ka ṉaa ka wx̱e.
Na' tole ye'lene': “Soashgo' mbalaz, na' gat'shga xalaano' na' dii yeej gawo'”, na' bi we'lene' daa chyalljile', bibi zejin ye'zlene' ka'.
Ka'kzan beena' nonḻilallee Chioza', shi bi chone' daa nak wen, bibi zjanayin ne' nonḻilalleene'.

Zoa beṉ' iṉe': “Li' no' nonḻilalloo Chioza', na' nad' chon' daa nak wen. Aga wakbe'i beṉ' shi nonḻilalloo Chioza' shi bi chono' daa nak wen. San nad', daa chon' daa nak wen chli'a nonḻilallaa Chioza'.”
Li' chajḻi'o toz Chiozan' zoa, na' wenkzan chono' chajḻi'o. Ḻekzka' dii xiw'ka' chajḻe'gakan na' ḻe chllebgakan.
Bi gono' ka beṉ' bi nteyi. Chiyaḻ' gakbe'ilo' shi bi chono' daa nak wen, bibi zjanayin no' chajḻi'o c̱he Chioza'.
Daa bzani dii x̱ozxto'cho Abrahama' xiiṉe' Isaaca', bc̱hi'eb' lo yaana' nan lljete'b' ka goll Chioza'ne' gone', na' wna Chioza' nak dii Abrahama' beṉ' wen lawe'na'.
¿Abi chakbe'ilo' daa benḻilall' dii Abrahama' Chiozan', bzanile' xiiṉe'na'? Na' daa bene' ka', bli'en nan dii ḻicha nonḻilallee Chioza'.
Na' billinin daa nyoj ḻee Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' daa nan: “Abrahama' wyajḻi'e c̱he Chioza', na' Chioza' wne' nake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' lawe'na'.” Na' wnagake' c̱he' goke' to beṉ' bllagui Chioza'.
Na' chakbe'ile beena' chonḻilallee Chioza' nake' beṉ' wen lawe'na' shi chone' ka cheenile', na' aga to daa iṉaze' nonḻilalleene'.

Ka'kzə gok c̱he noolə wdana' wle Rahab. Chioza' wne' nake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' daa bkwashee ḻoo lille'na' beṉ'ka' jawia jayi lalle'na', na' bigwee ḻegake' to nez yoblə ka bichejgake' lalle'na' kwenc̱he kono bet ḻegake'.
Ka chak c̱he to kwerp, shi bi yoon bishbe, netan, ka'kzan beena' to nonḻilall'ze' Chioza' na' bi chone' ka cheenile', bibi zjanayin nonḻilalleene'.
